title: NFTminter feat. Polygon
description: NFTs are being auctioned for tens of millions of dollars, and some very huge corporations are looking at them. When you factor in the mysticism and fervor with which crypto coin aficionados regard the blockchain, you have a full-fledged hype phenomena on your hands. With all of the money and attention being thrown into NFTs, it's becoming more and more likely that they'll be big money and big business.
how_its_made: Being a beginner, it was fun and challenging to implement a minter
